# AudioInfo { #timetoalign.loader.AudioInfo }

```python
loader.AudioInfo(
    n_samples,
    sample_rate,
    channels,
    duration_seconds,
    format,
    subtype=None,
    bits_per_sample=None,
    source_path=None,
    extra=dict(),
    backend=None,
)
```

Metadata for an audio file.

This dataclass holds all relevant information about an audio file
that is needed to create a physical timeline.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name             | Type                                                                                  | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
|------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| n_samples        | [int](`int`)                                                                          | Total number of samples in the file (frames). Exact from the soundfile, wave and riff backends and, on the mutagen backend, for an MP4 file (the count its boxes state); estimated from the stated duration on the mutagen backend otherwise. |
| sample_rate      | [int](`int`)                                                                          | Sample rate in Hz (e.g., 44100, 48000).                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| channels         | [int](`int`)                                                                          | Number of audio channels (1=mono, 2=stereo).                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| duration_seconds | [float](`float`)                                                                      | Duration in seconds: ``n_samples / sample_rate`` where the count is exact, the duration the file states where mutagen's count is an estimate.                                                                                                 |
| format           | [str](`str`)                                                                          | Audio format/codec (e.g., "WAV", "FLAC", "MP3").                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| subtype          | [str](`str`) \| None                                                                  | Audio subtype/encoding (e.g., "PCM_16", "PCM_24", "VORBIS").                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| bits_per_sample  | [int](`int`) \| None                                                                  | Bit depth (e.g., 16, 24, 32). May be None for lossy formats.                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| source_path      | [Path](`pathlib.Path`) \| None                                                        | Path to the source file.                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| extra            | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\]                                   | Additional format-specific metadata.                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| backend          | [Literal](`typing.Literal`)\[\'soundfile\', \'wave\', \'riff\', \'mutagen\'\] \| None | The backend that read the file: ``"soundfile"``, ``"wave"``, ``"riff"`` or ``"mutagen"``; None for metadata not read by the loader.                                                                                                           |
